entities.summary: Germain Gigounon is a Belgian tennis coach and a former professional player. Gigounon has a career high ATP singles ranking of World No. 185, achieved in August 2015, and a career high ATP doubles ranking of No. 253, achieved in March 2015. Gigounon has won 15 ITF singles titles and 13 ITF doubles titles.
